text: でんわ　してるんだ！

structure.jp: でんわ　してるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something that is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. でんわ　してる = 'I am phoning'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives an explanation with some force; んだ is its spoken form. してるんだ = 'I'm doing it, can't you see'.
